chapters.title: Success Through Consistency
chapters.summary: Success depends on daily consistency, not motivation or mindset, and the 9091 rule can help maintain it.

chapters.title: Mastering Through Routine
chapters.summary: Consistent, boring practice builds mastery, while chasing novelty or relying on fleeting feelings prevents sustained success.

chapters.title: Identity Anchors Consistency
chapters.summary: The speaker explains that while motivation fluctuates, building identity through consistent daily non‑negotiable rituals—like the 90‑minute 90‑90 rule—removes decision fatigue and anchors long‑term success.

chapters.title: Morning Focus Discipline
chapters.summary: The speaker explains how reducing daily decisions, leveraging peak mental energy early in the day, and building identity-based consistency can transform discipline into freedom and foster deep work.

chapters.title: Identity Keystone Habits
chapters.summary: The talk explains how repeated actions reshape self‑identity, turning behavior into habit, and suggests focusing on one key daily habit for 90 days to drive lasting change.

chapters.title: Daily Deep Work Rituals
chapters.summary: The speaker explains how to carve out a 90‑minute distraction‑free work block each day, track it with a Seinfeld‑style calendar, and anticipate resistance to build lasting productivity habits.

chapters.title: Building Consistent Habits
chapters.summary: Use missed days as data to refine routines, building consistency and self‑trust over 90 days.

takeaways: Daily consistency trumps motivation for success
Consistent boring practice builds mastery over chasing novelty
90‑minute daily rituals anchor identity and reduce decision fatigue
Early‑morning focus leverages peak energy for deep work
Track a 90‑day streak to reinforce habits and adapt from missed days
